summary_what_it_does: BRANCH DECODE (sibling of ...388003/388004). Creates the 2026 Merged Zoning Lot on Manhattan B1446 from three predecessor zoning lots: the 1995 Condominium Zoning Lot (Knickerbocker units 1101-1181 + lot 51 + lot 52), the Lot 151 Land, and the 2024 Developer Zoning Lot (lots 1/2/3 + lot 4). Certified total LAND area 22,987.14 SF. MTA (condemned lot 51 in 2010) consents and waives via annexed Acknowledgment. Owner grants a forward blanket waiver letting the Developer later enlarge, subdivide, or transfer rights without a new Knickerbocker signature.
